output.moret_status: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); if [ -z "$L" ]; then echo 'NO OUTPUT'; else LC_ALL=C awk 'function clean(s){gsub(/[ \t]+/," ",s); sub(/^ /,"",s); sub(/ $/,"",s); return s} function crash(f,  l,c){c=""; while((getline l < f)>0) if(c=="" && l ~ /forrtl: |[Ss]egmentation fault|SIGSEGV|Aborted|Killed|command not found|commande introuvable/) c=clean(l); close(f); return c} /^Error message number / && m=="" {e=1; n=0} e {if($0 ~ /^[ \t]*$/) e=0; else {if(n<5) m=m (m==""?"":" ") clean($0); n++; if($0 ~ /expected keyword/) e=0}; next} /^ *[|] +ABNORMAL END OF THE CALCULATION +[|]/ {ab=1} /^ *[|] +NORMAL END OF THE CALCULATION +[|]/ {ok=1} /^ *[|] +STOP OPTION +[|]/ {stop=1} END{sub(/:$/,".",m); if(ab) print "ABNORMAL END" (m==""?"":": " m); else if(ok && stop) print "NORMAL END (STOP OPTION, NO SIMULATION)"; else if(ok) print "NORMAL END"; else {c=crash("moret.log"); if(c=="") c=crash("err.txt"); if(c=="") c=crash("out.txt"); s="NO END BANNER"; if(m!="") s=s ": " m; if(c!="") s=s ": " c; print s}}' "$L"; fi
output.mean_keff: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk '/^##.*LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="+/-"){print $(i-1); exit}}' "$L"
output.sigma_keff: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk '/^##.*LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="+/-"){print $(i+1); exit}}' "$L"
output.keff_estimator: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk '/^##.*LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./ && k=="" {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="+/-"){k=$(i-1); s=$(i+1)}; next} k!="" && /^##/ {for(i=3;i<NF;i++) if($i=="+/-") break; if(i<NF && $(i-1)==k && $(i+1)==s){n=""; for(j=2;j<i-1;j++) n=n (n==""?"":" ") $j; print n; exit}}' "$L"
output.active_cycles: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk '/^##.*LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./{for(i=1;i<NF;i++) if($i=="CYCLE"){print $(i+1); exit}}' "$L"
output.transient_cycles: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk '/SUPPRESSION OF THE GREATEST NUMBER OF CYCLES/{t=1; next} t && /^ *[|] +[0-9]+ /{print $2; exit}' "$L"
output.dkeff: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk -v f=1 '/^##/{if($0~/PERTURBED SYSTEM NO/){match($0,/NO +[0-9]+/);s=substr($0,RSTART+3,RLENGTH-3)+0} else if(s>0 && $0~/LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./){for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="+/-"){m[s]=$(i-1);d[s]=$(i+1)}; s=0} if($0~/TAYLOR SERIES EXPANSION/) t=1; if(t && $2~/^[0-9]+$/ && $4=="+/-"){m[$2]=$3;d[$2]=$5}} END{o=""; for(k=1;k in m;k++){v=(f==1?m[k]:d[k]); sub(/^\+/,"",v); o=o (o==""?"":", ") "\"" k "\": " v}; print "{" o "}"}' "$L"
output.sigma_dkeff: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk -v f=2 '/^##/{if($0~/PERTURBED SYSTEM NO/){match($0,/NO +[0-9]+/);s=substr($0,RSTART+3,RLENGTH-3)+0} else if(s>0 && $0~/LOWEST SIGMA ESTI\./){for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="+/-"){m[s]=$(i-1);d[s]=$(i+1)}; s=0} if($0~/TAYLOR SERIES EXPANSION/) t=1; if(t && $2~/^[0-9]+$/ && $4=="+/-"){m[$2]=$3;d[$2]=$5}} END{o=""; for(k=1;k in m;k++){v=(f==1?m[k]:d[k]); sub(/^\+/,"",v); o=o (o==""?"":", ") "\"" k "\": " v}; print "{" o "}"}' "$L"
output.moret_warnings: L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || LC_ALL=C awk '/^Information message number [0-9]+ from WARN_/{k=$6 " " $4; if(!(k in c)) o[++n]=k; c[k]++} END{s=""; for(i=1;i<=n;i++) s=s (s==""?"":", ") o[i] (c[o[i]]>1?" (x" c[o[i]] ")":""); if(s!="") print s}' "$L"
output.cpu_time: X=$(ls *.out.xml *.out.xml.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1); v=''; [ -z "$X" ] || v=$(gzip -dcf "$X" | LC_ALL=C awk '/<cpu_time>/{c=1} c && /<global>/{s=$0; sub(/.*<global>/,"",s); sub(/<.*/,"",s); print s; exit}'); if [ -z "$v" ]; then L=$(ls *.listing 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^apo2\.listing$' | head -1); [ -z "$L" ] || v=$(LC_ALL=C awk '/^global +:/{print $3; exit}' "$L"); fi; [ -z "$v" ] || echo "$v"
